verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing says it automates recurring fixes and offers monitoring policies, remote script execution and an AI agent (Tia) that predicts, prevents and fixes IT issues. That points to a first-party background-automation capability. However, the evidence is only one-line marketing claims, with no documentation of how users build, schedule or trigger automations. Remote script execution alone reads as a one-off action rather than a recurring autonomous job. Missing for 10: documented automation builder or workflow setup, scheduling or trigger configuration, evidence of unattended autonomous execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Reduce manual workload by automating recurring fixes.
Custom monitoring policies ... Remote script execution ... Instant alerts
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
